slots.name: 00: Morning Intake
slots.objective: Log last night by hand before the day starts.

slots.name: 01: Morning Light
slots.objective: Outdoor light within an hour of waking. Fires on your first message of the day; 08:15 is the backstop.

slots.name: 02: Morning Reflection
slots.objective: Re-anchor identity as a high-performance sleeper upon waking.

slots.name: 03: Midday Essentialism
slots.objective: Front-load execution so work does not spill into the evening.

slots.name: 04: Afternoon Boundary
slots.objective: Lock tonight's decisions while you still can: dinner timing, shutdown time, kombucha cutoff.

slots.name: 05: Evening Wind-Down
slots.objective: Begin light reduction and thermal drop.

slots.name: 06: Blue Blockers
slots.objective: Cut short-wavelength light three hours before target bedtime.

slots.name: 07: Hard Work Shutdown
slots.objective: Non-negotiable shutdown on laptops and work communications.

slots.name: 08: Terminal Bedtime Anchor
slots.objective: Immediate screen shutdown and final transition to bed.
